thread:
Marta L: Heads-up, CS just escalated a P1 from BrightMaps — Dedicated pool in ap-south-2. They report a sudden spike in 5xxs and huge tail latency since ~02:10 UTC. Placement errors + autoscaler not spawning new nodes.

Kevin R: Can you paste the error they saw? any request IDs?

Marta L: Copied from the customer: 
```
error=placement_failure region=ap-south-2 pool=dedicated-prod-84 attempt=3 reason=NO_AVAILABLE_GPUS
request_id=rm-7c9f3a2b
latency_ms=12000 status=504
```
They also saw repeated 429s when retrying.

Anya K: 429s during placement retries suggests our placement service started returning "capacity throttled" instead of queueing. I'm pulling scheduler logs now. @infra-oncall are there any maintenance events in ap-south-2?

infra-oncall: No scheduled infra maintenance. Seeing a growth in GPU allocations from a single tenant cluster in ap-south-2 since 01:30 UTC. Looks like a noisy tenant consumed much of the available spare nodes. Autoscaler attempted to allocate new nodes but failed with quota/stock error: 
```
allocate_node: failed reason=GPU_STOCKOUT provider=cloud-provider-x zone=ap-south-2a
quota_override=false
```
We also have a backlog of placement retries hitting our rate limiter.

Samir P: Which rate limiter? is it per-pool or per-region? That could explain 429s on placement.

Kevin R: Placement service has two layers: per-pool token bucket + global provisioning rate. If provisioning fails due to stockout, retries escalate and hit the global provisioner throttle. That then surfaces as 429s to clients.

Marta L: Customer says their auto-rollout was blocked and they hit billing alarms. CS forwarded a billing alert showing "reserved capacity not honored" for their Dedicated contract. Billing bot, any correlating invoice anomalies?

billing-bot: Alert: 2026-11-08T02:25 UTC — usage mismatch flagged for acct BrightMaps. No invoice issued yet, but tokens show queued requests that did not map to reserved GPUs.

Anya K: Repro steps we should run: 1) Simulate a placement request against ap-south-2 dedicated pool with same pool tags. 2) Force provider to return GPU_STOCKOUT to validate our retry behavior. 3) Observe autoscaler decision path and global throttle counters. I'll run a dry repro in staging with a smaller quota.

Samir P: For mitigation: - Ramp down noisy tenant if possible (we have their allocation id). - Temporarily increase provisioner quota for ap-south-2 (manual override) to allow burst allocations. - Open cross-region failover to eu-south as a controlled fallback for BrightMaps until stock replenishes.

Kevin R: I agree. Assigning tasks: Anya -> repro and reproduce failure mode, Samir -> contact capacity ops to request short-term quota bump, @infra-oncall -> throttle/noisy-tenant remediation and watch placement queue. Marta -> CS notify customer about planned failover and mitigation steps.

Reliability SRE: Also adding a short-term policy: when provider returns GPU_STOCKOUT, we should not escalate retries aggressively; instead enter backoff and start cross-region placement earlier. I'll draft an emergency change to placement backoff parameters after we confirm repro.

Marta L: Noted. I'll send the customer a status update now. Tagging @kevin for postmortem once stable. BrightMaps is on an enterprise Dedicated plan; Sales + Success are looped.

Kevin R: Repro started. Initial staging run yields identical response from simulated provider. Confirmed: provisioner increments retry counter and immediately triggers global throttle when failures exceed threshold.

Anya K: Logs snippet from staging (sanitized):
```
[02:12:15] provisioner: allocate_node start pool=dedicated-prod-84
[02:12:16] provider: respond GPU_STOCKOUT
[02:12:16] provisioner: retry_count=1 backoff_ms=200
[02:12:16] global-throttle: tokens_remaining=0 -> return 429
[02:12:17] placement: placement_failure NO_AVAILABLE_GPUS
```

Samir P: Capacity ops approved temporary quota bump for 20 minutes to drain backlogs. I've throttled the noisy tenant allocation by 60% (allocation id: alloc-9b2). Monitoring impact.

infra-oncall: After throttling noisy tenant we see placement queue drop and successful allocations for BrightMaps. Customer traffic now routing to newly provisioned nodes in ap-south-2a. Latency returning to normal range.

Marta L: Customer on call confirms degraded behavior improving. They're asking for root cause and preventive steps. Reliability SRE, can you track the follow-up RFC (placement backoff + early cross-region failover) and include autoscaler safeguards?

Reliability SRE: Yep — will file RFC and include rollout plan + feature flag. Also recommending an observability alert: if provider returns >20 GPU_STOCKOUTs in 5m, trigger capacity-ops paging automatically.

Marta L: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread open until postmortem. Closing the immediate mitigation: quota bump expired but traffic stable.

Kevin R: Will own postmortem. Initial summary: noisy tenant caused rapid consumption of spare GPUs in ap-south-2 -> provider returned GPU_STOCKOUT -> our provisioner retried and hit global throttle -> clients saw 429/504 -> autoscaler did not scale due to provider stockout. Mitigations: noisy tenant throttle, short-term quota bump, adjust placement backoff.

Marta L: Adding final note: CS and Sales want timeline for preventing recurrence. Let's aim for a patch to placement backoff + alerting in the next 72h and RFC for cross-region failover within 2 weeks.

infra-oncall: Logged runbook updates and updated oncall playbook.

Samir P: Closing actions assigned in jira: INFRA-3221 (throttle noisy tenant), INFRA-3222 (provisioner backoff patch), INFRA-3223 (auto page on repeated GPU_STOCKOUT).

Marta L: Thanks team.
